description: A free-mint verifier for AI agents on BSC. Give it a contract address and it answers live on-chain whether that contract is a free, gas-only Agent ID mint (FREE / LIKELY_FREE / PAID / UNKNOWN). The free tier probes any contract via the on-chain MintBeacon verifier. The paid deep check ($0.01) resolves LIKELY_FREE cases with source verification plus a simulation from the payer's own address, and risk flags.
draftNote: Ready to submit only once a paid flow is confirmed working. The free tier is live via probeMint on-chain. The paid lane is NOT live.
